sources.title: SQLite FTS5 Extension
sources.version_or_commit: Living official documentation accessed 2026-10-12T01:09Z; FTS5 included in amalgamation since SQLite 3.9.0; runtime version unspecified
sources.locator: Sections 2.1, 3, 4.3.1–4.3.4, 4.4, 6.7, 6.12; especially Unicode61 tokenizer, external content pitfalls, rebuild command
sources.observed_operation: Read query grammar, tokenizer defaults, external/contentless table semantics, trigger examples, consistency pitfalls and rebuild command.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: unicode61 is the default; Unicode 6.1 categories with Latin diacritic removal by default; external-content data must be synchronized by caller; triggers do not backfill existing rows; rebuild deletes then reconstructs; contentless has no rebuild command; trigram full-text needs at least three Unicode characters.
sources.applicability: Candidate local lexical index; verify runtime FTS5 build and expected token behavior. Same-database external content avoids an index text copy but may couple index writes to note writes.

sources.title: SQLite Write-Ahead Logging
sources.version_or_commit: WAL available since SQLite 3.7.0; living official documentation
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Readers and a writer may operate concurrently in WAL mode, but only one writer at a time; long readers can prevent checkpoint progress; WAL requires all processes on one host and does not work on a network filesystem.
sources.applicability: Local SQLite notebook/index design; test same-database index writes and rebuild reads for edit contention and WAL growth.

sources.title: SQLite forum: external-content FTS5 with nested AFTER UPDATE trigger writes
sources.version_or_commit: Forum report dated 2026-08-04/05; reports reproductions on SQLite 3.45.1, 3.45.3 and 3.53.2; no formal release fix identified in this record
sources.locator: Posts 1-4, especially corrected reproducer (post 3), maintainer explanation/workaround (posts 4); issue status Resolved
sources.observed_operation: Read SQLite Fossil bug/forum report, corrected trigger reproducer and maintainer response.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The reported issue requires external-content FTS5 sync after-update behavior combined with another AFTER UPDATE trigger that performs a nested write to the same content table; trigger ordering can cause FTS sync to observe unintended old/new values. Maintainer recommends avoiding such a nested-write trigger or folding the change into the original update.
sources.applicability: If using FTS5 external-content triggers, inspect all triggers on the canonical table and avoid nested same-table writes; test the actual trigger graph and selected SQLite runtime. This is not evidence that all external-content trigger designs fail.
